subject.facility_name: COOK WILLOW HEALTH & REHABILITATION CENTER, INC.

executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $152.72 per resident day (39.6% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $5,103,018 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 15,055 Medicaid days, $338.96 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $336.36 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $337.50 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 1.8% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $31,060, 1.0% of the $3,069,910 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $889,469, $44.25 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $439,858 (49.5%), allocated fringe $79,995 (9.0%), non-wage costs $369,616 (41.6%). Raw food was $337,238 ($16.78 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $273,712, $13.62 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $201,658 (73.7%), allocated fringe $36,675 (13.4%), non-wage costs $35,379 (12.9%).
Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 7 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $55,324 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Raw Food (page 18 line 2a1), removed $46,604; Other Dietary 1 (page 18 line 2c1), added $27,348; Other Maintenance Workers (page 10 line A7b), removed $14,263. Separately, the home itself removed $560,224 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
